description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Graham Capital Management, L.P. is seeking a junior-to-mid-level Software Developer for its Trading Technology team. The role maintains and enhances critical Windows client and server applications, supports trading systems, and contributes to new development projects for the firm’s quantitative and discretionary trading businesses.
Trading Technology Software Developer maintaining and developing Windows applications and supporting pre-trade signal and order-generation systems

Responsibilities:
• Working closely with developers and business users, primarily within the quantitative trading team, to gather requirements and scope projects
• Maintaining, enhancing, and updating existing Windows client and server applications, while also contributing to new development projects
• Analyzing existing systems for robustness and performance improvements
• Presenting ideas for system improvements, both technical and business-related
• Producing product specifications and training peers and users on system use and maintenance
• Performing unit, integration, and functional testing
• Maintaining and supporting business-critical pre-trade signal and order generation systems through UAT and production, with a focus on accuracy, reliability, and timely processing

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field
• 1-5 years of relevant software development experience; strong recent graduates with relevant internship, academic, or project experience will also be considered
• Strong object-oriented programming skills; C# is preferred, but strong candidates with experience in Java, Python, or another modern programming language will also be considered
• Experience with or strong knowledge of concurrency, automated unit testing, and SQL
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with developers and business users throughout the software development life cycle
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to developing reliable, thoroughly tested software

Preferred:
• C# is preferred
• Experience with event-driven architecture (messaging), F#, or functional programming (preferred)
